evals.prompt: I need to add multi-tenant support to this API: tenant-scoped auth, per-tenant rate limiting, tenant-aware DB queries, and an admin UI for managing tenants. Plan it out and split the work across agents.
evals.expected_output: Skill triggers. Produces .plan/<name>/plan.md with a concise indicative plan name, a file map assigning every path to exactly one phase-2 owner, an explicit shared-surface section owned by phase 1, and a 3-phase split (1 foundation agent, 2-4 phase-2 agents on disjoint paths, phase-3 review). Writes PROGRESS.md. Stops to confirm the plan before dispatching.
expectations: Creates a .plan/<plan-name>/ directory with a concise, indicative name (not 'plan1' or a long sentence)
plan.md contains a file map where no path has two phase-2 owners
Phase 1 is 1 agent (not 2, since this is not a monorepo spanning separate projects)
Shared surface (types, config, migrations, registries) is assigned to phase 1, not phase 2
PROGRESS.md is written before any dispatch and contains a 'Resume here' line
Confirms the plan with the user before dispatching any subagent
Runs the pre-flight check (precheck.sh) before or during planning

evals.expected_output: Skill triggers in resume mode. Reads .plan/*/PROGRESS.md, selects the unfinished plan, also reads agents/*.md, runs wt.sh list and git log, and reconciles the file against actual git state before acting. Does not blindly trust the Resume here line.
expectations: Locates the plan by listing .plan/*/PROGRESS.md rather than asking the user which plan
Reads agents/*.md, not just PROGRESS.md
Runs wt.sh list and git log to establish real state
States that git is ground truth and PROGRESS.md is intent when they disagree
Decides per live worktree: clean+ahead means verify and merge, UNCOMMITTED means inspect, clean+0-ahead means drop and re-dispatch
Updates PROGRESS.md to match reality before continuing work

evals.prompt: Build out the whole billing module for this project - subscriptions, invoices, webhooks, and the dunning flow. Use parallel agents.
evals.expected_output: In a repo under Desktop/Playgrounds, phase 3 runs code review only and explicitly skips the security agents, recording the skip and its reason in PROGRESS.md. In a repo outside that path, security agents run.
expectations: Checks the repository root path mechanically (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) to decide on security review
Skips the security agents when the repo is under Desktop/Playgrounds
Still runs the code-review agents producing CR.md
Records the security skip and its reason in PROGRESS.md
Does not silently omit the security phase without saying so

evals.prompt: Here's the plan directory for the auth refactor. Phase 2 agent p2-tokens says DONE. Merge its work and move on.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the critical-path tests inside the agent's worktree before merging (not in the main tree), uses wt.sh merge which removes the worktree and branch, then re-runs tests on the merged branch. Treats the agent's DONE as a claim requiring verification.
expectations: Runs the critical-path tests inside the worktree, not the main tree, before merging
Uses wt.sh merge rather than git merge plus manual worktree removal
Confirms the worktree and branch were removed after merging
Re-runs tests on the merged branch
Does not report success based only on the agent's STATUS: DONE
Folds the agent's report into PROGRESS.md immediately
